integration_requirements: Admit exclusive collector kind cloudbuild_log_source and public selected_cloudbuild_builds (1-4 unique exact resource-name strings, exactly one explicit project); validate before credentials using selected_builds(options, scopes).

Add KIND to supported types and dependencies {project, bucket}; exclude from default inventories and allow it only through named-check trusted content admission with strict boolean content_secret_scans=True and _content_secret_scan_kinds containing KIND as a list.

Schedule jobs(collector, scope) in the dependent phase after native project/bucket collection envelopes complete. It returns native (kind, scope, cloudbuild, fetch) tuples and performs its own Build GET; cloudbuild_build inventory and capture_response hooks are unnecessary.
Merge selection_metadata(collector) into context.metadata for requested KIND. The pure consumer requires cloudbuild_log_source_authorized=True.

Explicitly call peaso.checks.gcp_cloudbuild_log_secret_review_20261019.install() in root-owned registry admission; it loads redacted fixtures and is idempotent. This worker does not call install at import or edit registry init.

Admit DECLARATION in the existing secrets group with severity high and no numbered compliance mappings; add public presentation, source/fingerprint/validation contracts and canonical catalog entries only in root-owned files.
Run the centralized pytest nodes listed in pending_pytest_nodes using .venv/bin/python; the worker deliberately did not invoke pytest.

official_sources.supports: Exact regional Build GET and native build status/timing.
Build identity, logsBucket, documented log-${buildId}.txt convention and console-only logUrl.
Metadata GET, generation selection, ifGenerationMatch and alt=media.
bucket.projectNumber identifies the owning project number.
Independent CRM v3 native project ownership metadata.
GCS versus Cloud Logging storage choices and user-owned bucket limits.

request_contract.pinned_metadata: Same exact GCS object GET with generation and ifGenerationMatch equal to the discovered generation; existing reader fields/noAcl projection.
request_contract.pinned_media: Same exact GCS object GET with generation=ifGenerationMatch=observed generation and alt=media; existing bounded reader.
request_contract.enumeration: No Build LIST, object LIST, console logUrl, retries or inferred default buckets.

evidence_contract.provenance: Independent native CRM/bucket request references plus exact Build metadata GET, generation-discovery GET, pinned metadata GET and pinned media GET; six unique request references per successful build.
evidence_contract.privacy: No raw log text, credential values, logsBucket, full Build payloads or console URLs in adapter result/cache; object identity is opaque and bucket is hashed.

limitations: Default/shared Google-owned log buckets outside the independently bound selected project are UNKNOWN.
Active builds are UNKNOWN; terminal state does not claim historical log completeness.
Only the observed generation is inspected; later object replacements or alternative Logging history are outside scope.
Plain UTF-8 text only; archives/compressed logs are unsupported.
System python lacks kingfisher_sdk; the repository .venv supplies both required offline engines.
Root integration and centralized pytest remain intentionally outside worker file ownership.

root_integration.description: Observed generation only; complete historical build logs are explicitly unproved.

acceptance.scope: Affected content authorization, transport, owner binding, shared fixtures and natural evidence regression cohort; no live GCP validation.
